title: CR-BRK-018 — Send to Portal in Full View without WOL-approve ability
preconds: WO V \u2713 | View Mode: Full | WO Lines: (no Edit → cannot approve a WOL) (View Mode as specified).
steps:
1. Configure a custom role per the Setup in Preconditions; assign to a test user and log in.
  2. Open a WO in Full View with no WOL-approve ability; look for Send to Portal.
expected:
Send to Portal requires Full View AND the ability to approve a WOL (Q6: 'can be anyone who can approve a WOL'; approve = 'authorize lines' under WO Lines Edit). Without WOL Edit, Send to Portal should be unavailable even in Full View.

Risk / Rationale: Send to Portal available in Full View despite no WOL-approve capability — over-permission. (Exact gate mildly ambiguous.)
Spec Ref: §4 View Mode; §1b; Open Q6
Flag / Note: Spec ambiguity
